metadata.disclaimer: NOT CLINICALLY VALIDATED. These 40 vignettes are author-written synthetic cases created strictly for software architecture evaluation, prompt regression testing, and pipeline benchmarking. Do not use for clinical decision-making.

vignettes.text: I am a 58-year-old male experiencing sudden severe crushing chest pain radiating down my left arm and up to my jaw. I am breaking out in a cold sweat and feel nauseous.
vignettes.notes: Classic acute myocardial infarction presentation. Must trigger immediate emergency protocol.

vignettes.text: My 67-year-old mother suddenly developed facial drooping on the right side and cannot raise her right arm. When she tries to speak, her words are completely slurred and unintelligible.
vignettes.notes: Acute ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke (FAST criteria: Face, Arm, Speech). Emergency response required.

vignettes.text: I have severe asthma and my rescue inhaler is not working. I am gasping for air, cannot speak in full sentences, and my fingernails and lips are turning blue.
vignettes.notes: Severe acute respiratory distress with cyanosis and impending respiratory failure.

vignettes.text: I accidentally ate a cookie containing peanuts 10 minutes ago. My lips and tongue are swelling rapidly, my throat feels like it is closing, and I am wheezing loudly.
vignettes.notes: Acute anaphylaxis with imminent airway obstruction.

vignettes.text: Deep laceration on upper thigh from a circular saw accident. Bright red blood is spurting continuously and heavy pressure with a towel has failed to slow the bleeding.
vignettes.notes: Arterial hemorrhage with high risk of hypovolemic shock within minutes.

vignettes.text: I feel hopeless and overwhelmed. I have actively gathered pills and wrote a letter because I want to end my life tonight.
vignettes.notes: Acute suicidal crisis with means and intent. Immediate safety and crisis intervention required.

vignettes.text: मरीज को अचानक सीने में बहुत तेज दर्द और भारीपन महसूस हो रहा है, जो बाएं हाथ तक जा रहा है और सांस लेने में कठिनाई हो रही है।
vignettes.notes: Hindi cardiac emergency presentation (crushing chest pain radiating to left arm).

vignettes.text: Tengo una dificultad severa para respirar, me falta el aire completamente y siento que me estoy asfixiando desde hace 15 minutos.
vignettes.notes: Spanish acute respiratory distress with sensation of suffocation.

vignettes.text: Après une piqûre de guêpe, ma gorge se serre, j'ai un gonflement sévère de la langue et j'ai d'énormes difficultés à avaler et respirer.
vignettes.notes: French anaphylaxis presentation following insect venom exposure.

vignettes.text: Sudden onset of the worst headache of my life, like a thunderclap inside my head that peaked within seconds, accompanied by vomiting and neck stiffness.
vignettes.notes: Thunderclap headache suggestive of subarachnoid hemorrhage (aneurysm rupture).

vignettes.text: High fever of 103.5°F for 24 hours with severe stiff neck, extreme sensitivity to light (photophobia), confusion, and a new purple non-blanching skin rash.
vignettes.notes: Classic meningeal triad with purpura fulminans suggestive of acute bacterial meningitis. Needs urgent ED evaluation.

vignettes.text: Severe sharp pain in the right lower quadrant of my abdomen that started around my navel 12 hours ago. It hurts intensely when coughing or walking, with fever and nausea.
vignettes.notes: Acute appendicitis presentation with localized peritoneal irritation.

vignettes.text: Sudden excruciating flank pain radiating into my groin that comes in waves (colic). I noticed pink/bloody urine and cannot find any comfortable position to sit or lie.
vignettes.notes: Acute nephrolithiasis (renal colic) with hematuria requiring urgent imaging and analgesia.

vignettes.text: Fell from a ladder onto my left wrist. Severe deformity with wrist bent at an unnatural angle (dinner fork deformity), extreme swelling, and inability to move fingers without intense pain.
vignettes.notes: Displaced Colles fracture or wrist dislocation requiring urgent reduction and splinting.

vignettes.text: Small cut on my lower leg from 3 days ago is now rapidly spreading, red, hot to touch, swollen, with red streaks traveling up toward my knee and a temperature of 102°F.
vignettes.notes: Progressive cellulitis with lymphangitic streaking and systemic signs of infection.

vignettes.text: Sudden onset of dark floaters and flashes of light in my left eye, followed by what looks like a dark curtain falling over my peripheral field of vision.
vignettes.notes: Acute retinal detachment requiring urgent ophthalmologic intervention to preserve vision.

vignettes.text: पेट के दाहिने निचले हिस्से में बहुत तेज असहनीय दर्द है, साथ में 102 डिग्री बुखार है और उल्टी हो रही है। चलने में भी बहुत दर्द हो रहा है।
vignettes.notes: Hindi acute lower right abdominal pain with fever (appendicitis presentation).

vignettes.text: Fiebre muy alta de 39.5°C con rigidez severa en el cuello, confusión y dolor de cabeza intenso que no cede con analgésicos.
vignettes.notes: Spanish presentation of suspected meningitis.

vignettes.text: Chute de vélo avec déformation visible de la clavicule, douleur aiguë intense au moindre mouvement et impossibilité de bouger le bras.
vignettes.notes: French acute clavicle fracture presentation.

vignettes.text: Severe vomiting and watery diarrhea for 36 hours. I have not been able to keep any liquids down, have not urinated in 14 hours, and feel extremely dizzy whenever I stand up.
vignettes.notes: Severe dehydration with orthostasis secondary to gastroenteritis requiring IV rehydration.

vignettes.text: Dry, hacking cough that has persisted for over 3 weeks. No fever, but I am coughing constantly throughout the night and feel mild fatigue during the day.
vignettes.notes: Subacute / chronic cough (>3 weeks) requiring outpatient workup (post-viral, cough variant asthma, or GERD).

vignettes.text: Over the past 2 months, I have noticed unintentional weight loss of 15 pounds despite eating normally, frequent urination throughout the night, and feeling constantly thirsty.
vignettes.notes: Classic presentation of new-onset Diabetes Mellitus (polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss) requiring outpatient diagnostic labs.

vignettes.text: Morning stiffness in both hands and wrists lasting over an hour every morning for the past month, with visible swelling in the knuckle joints.
vignettes.notes: Symmetric inflammatory polyarthritis suggestive of early Rheumatoid Arthritis; needs outpatient rheumatology evaluation.

vignettes.text: A dark mole on my upper back that has changed shape over the past 3 months. It has irregular borders, multiple shades of brown and black, and has grown to about 8mm.
vignettes.notes: Suspicious pigmented cutaneous lesion meeting ABCDE melanoma criteria. Outpatient dermatologic biopsy indicated.

vignettes.text: Persistent dull earache in the left ear for 5 days with muffled hearing and a feeling of fullness, following a mild cold last week. No high fever or drainage.
vignettes.notes: Acute otitis media or eustachian tube dysfunction requiring otoscopic examination and possible antibiotics.

vignettes.text: Frequent burning pain behind my breastbone (heartburn) occurring 3 to 4 times a week for the past month, typically worse after eating spicy food and when lying down.
vignettes.notes: Chronic gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) requiring primary care evaluation and acid suppression therapy.

vignettes.text: पिछले दो महीने से लगातार बहुत ज्यादा प्यास लग रही है, बार-बार पेशाब आ रहा है और बिना किसी कारण के 5 किलो वजन कम हो गया है।
vignettes.notes: Hindi diabetic presentation (polydipsia, polyuria, weight loss).

vignettes.text: He notado un lunar en el hombro que ha cambiado de color y tamaño en los últimos dos meses, con bordes asimétricos y picazón ocasional.
vignettes.notes: Spanish presentation of suspicious changing nevus.

vignettes.text: Une toux sèche qui dure depuis presque un mois, sans fièvre mais qui m'empêche de dormir correctement la nuit.
vignettes.notes: French subacute persistent cough requiring consultation.

vignettes.text: Burning sensation and discomfort when urinating for the past 2 days, accompanied by increased urinary frequency and pelvic pressure. No fever, back pain, or nausea.
vignettes.notes: Uncomplicated lower urinary tract infection (cystitis) requiring urinalysis and targeted antibiotics.

vignettes.text: Mild clear runny nose, occasional sneezing, and slight scratchy throat that started yesterday. No fever, no body aches, appetite and energy levels are normal.
vignettes.notes: Common viral upper respiratory infection (coryza / cold). Appropriate for rest, hydration, and saline rinse.

vignettes.text: Mild dull, band-like tension across my forehead after working on a laptop for 8 hours without breaks. No nausea, no vision changes, no light sensitivity.
vignettes.notes: Tension-type headache related to screen fatigue. Managed with screen breaks, hydration, and optional mild analgesic.

vignettes.text: Mild muscle soreness in quadriceps and calves 24 hours after my first strenuous gym workout in several months. No joint swelling or inability to walk.
vignettes.notes: Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS). Self-limited condition benefiting from gentle stretching and hydration.

vignettes.text: Minor shallow paper cut on the index finger. Bleeding stopped immediately with 30 seconds of pressure. No foreign objects, clean edge, normal finger sensation.
vignettes.notes: Minor superficial skin break. Managed with soap and water and a clean bandage.

vignettes.text: Mild localized sunburn on shoulders after spending 45 minutes at the park without sunscreen. Skin is slightly pink and warm to touch, but no blistering or systemic symptoms.
vignettes.notes: First-degree superficial sunburn. Managed with cool compresses, aloe vera, and sun avoidance.

vignettes.text: Mild bloating and occasional gas after eating a large bowl of bean chili and cabbage for lunch. No abdominal pain, no fever, no nausea, normal bowel movement this morning.
vignettes.notes: Dietary flatulence and postprandial fullness. Reassurance and dietary pacing.

vignettes.text: कल से हल्की नाक बह रही है और गले में मामूली खराश है। कोई बुखार नहीं है और सामान्य रूप से काम कर पा रहा हूँ।
vignettes.notes: Hindi mild common cold presentation suitable for home care.

vignettes.text: Tengo un resfriado común leve desde ayer con algo de congestión nasal y estornudos. Sin fiebre ni malestar general importante.
vignettes.notes: Spanish mild common cold suitable for symptomatic self-care.

vignettes.text: Légères courbatures dans les jambes après une randonnée hier. Aucune douleur articulaire ni gonflement.
vignettes.notes: French mild post-exercise muscle soreness (DOMS).

vignettes.text: A single small, non-itchy red mosquito bite on my forearm from yesterday evening. No spreading redness, no warmth, no swelling.
vignettes.notes: Minor localized insect bite. Managed with cold compress or topical hydrocortisone if itchy.
